headline: Three Overtimes and a Power Poll Shake-Up Define Week 3
subhead: Tennessee, LSU, and Miami survive extra frames while Arkansas and Notre Dame crash the top four.
lead: Week 3 delivered three overtime thrillers and a seismic shift at the top of the power poll, where Tennessee, LSU, and Texas remain the only unbeatens. Arkansas vaulted six spots to tie Notre Dame at No. 4 after a 41-18 dismantling of Penn State.

segments.title: Tennessee Outlasts Ohio State in Overtime
segments.body: Ohio State led 10-0 after one quarter and 13-8 at halftime before Tennessee forced a 29-29 deadlock after four quarters. The Volunteers won 35-29 in overtime in a game that featured five turnovers and a single lead change.

segments.title: LSU Survives Michigan in Extra Time
segments.body: LSU never trailed, leading 17-14 at halftime and holding a 24-14 edge after three quarters, but Michigan rallied to knot the score at 24-24. The Tigers answered in overtime with a six-point finish to stay perfect at 3-0.

segments.title: Miami Stuns USC in Overtime
segments.body: A scoreless first quarter gave way to a back-and-forth affair that saw Miami erase a 14-11 halftime deficit and force overtime tied at 28. The Hurricanes then put up six unanswered points in the extra period to hand USC a loss that dropped the Trojans to 2-1.

segments.title: Arkansas and Notre Dame Crash the Top Four
segments.body: Arkansas surged from No. 10 to a share of No. 4 after a 41-18 rout of Penn State that featured a 23-point maximum lead. Notre Dame joined them at No. 4 following a 41-28 win at Georgia in which the Irish outscored the Bulldogs 24-7 in the second half.

segments.title: Texas, Tennessee, LSU Stand Alone at 3-0
segments.body: Texas blew the doors off UCLA with a 24-point second quarter en route to a 55-20 victory, joining Tennessee and LSU as the league's only undefeated teams. The Longhorns never trailed and forced one turnover while building a 35-point maximum lead.

closer: Next week puts the unbeaten trio on high alert as Tennessee, LSU, and Texas each face ranked opponents with playoff positioning already on the line.
